requirement.description: The RLP encoding implementation has several issues causing test failures. The main problems are: 1) Inconsistent handling of different data types in rlp_encode function, 2) Incorrect implementation of RLP encoding for integers and addresses, 3) Missing proper error handling for edge cases.
requirement.contract: Fix the rlp_encode function to correctly implement Ethereum RLP encoding standards for integers, strings, and lists. Ensure consistent behavior for all data types and modes (text, hex). The function should properly encode data according to RLP specifications and return correct hex-encoded strings.

requirement.description: The RLP decoding implementation has issues with handling different data types and modes. Tests fail because the decoding functions don't properly handle various input formats and return incorrect data structures.
requirement.contract: Fix the rlp_decode function to correctly decode RLP-encoded data according to Ethereum RLP specifications. The function should properly handle different types (ascii, raw_hex, prefix_hex) and return appropriate Python data structures (strings, lists, etc.) matching the expected test outputs.

requirement.description: The cryptographic functions (private_key_to_public_key, private_key_to_address, sign_message_hash, get_signer_public_key) fail due to missing dependencies (ecdsa, hashlib) and incorrect implementation logic. Tests fail with ImportError or incorrect signature calculations.
requirement.contract: Ensure cryptographic functions properly handle missing dependencies by raising informative ImportError messages. Fix the implementation of signature creation and recovery to match Ethereum standards and produce correct VRS signatures.

requirement.description: The CLI command for RLP encoding has parsing issues and doesn't handle input correctly. The command fails when trying to process certain inputs due to improper handling of string/hex detection and parameter passing.
requirement.contract: Fix the rlp_encode_command function to properly parse input data and handle both string and hex inputs. Ensure the command correctly passes parameters to the underlying rlp_encode function and outputs the correct encoded result.

requirement.description: The code import test fails because some modules are missing the required future annotations import. The test identifies files that lack the "from __future__ import annotations" statement.
requirement.contract: Add the required "from __future__ import annotations" statement to all Python files in the codebase to satisfy the import test requirements.
